fixed.explanation: ArrowExtensionArray._str_extract raises when the pattern has no named groups, and it keys its results by group name only. Unnamed groups are therefore dropped or fail. The fix builds keys by position: the group name if the group has one, otherwise its 0-based index. Group extraction is now positional, using index i+1 in the flags path and struct fields in order in the kernel path.

input.intent: The Arrow-backed string extension array's str.extract implementation (_str_extract) splits regex capture groups into columns. It must label unnamed groups by position (0, 1, ...) like the object dtype, rather than failing or dropping columns.
input.symptom: str.extract with unnamed capture groups on an Arrow-backed string Series fails or drops columns instead of labelling the groups by position.
